Fixes and improvements

  • Add alphabet, arabic, typography and character tags to alphabet-arabic (#1643)
  • Match brand-instagram size to other square brand icons (#1615)
  • Fix square-dashed icon drawn as a solid square (#1614)
  • Redraw square-dashed and table-dashed icons (#1640)
  • Add squircle tag to all square-rounded icons (#1641)
  • Webfont: Fix filled home webfont glyph having zero width in Chrome (#1616)
  • Webfont: Fix sass and style fields in package.json to point to dist/, and stop publishing the intermediate SVG fonts, which the CSS never referenced (#1633)
  • Webfont: Make webfont builds reproducible, so font files no longer change between builds of the same icons (#1624)
  • Webfont: Drop the unused svgtofont dependency (#1620)
  • Astro, Preact, React, React Native, SolidJS, Vue: Stop publishing source maps, which made up about 70% of the package size (#1634)
  • Svelte, Svelte Runes: Add default export conditions and document per-icon imports (#1630)
  • React Native: Stop passing extra props (testID, style, onPress, …) to every node of the icon, only the root Svg gets them. title is now exposed to screen readers via accessibility props (#1628)

cua-driver-rs-v0.33.4cua-driver-rs: v0.33.4 Prerelease2026-10-05T06:04:19Z

Cua Driver 0.33.4

Summary

This release includes 2 fixes.

Fixes

  • support multi-monitor Hyprland desktops. (#4305) Thanks @Iann29, @CARLOSDAVID33; reported by @praxis1244-consulting.
  • recognize captured Chinese browser consent. (#4590) Thanks @loonghao.

Contributors

Thanks to @CARLOSDAVID33, @Iann29, @loonghao, @praxis1244-consulting for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-driver-rs-v0.33.3cua-driver-rs: v0.33.3 Prerelease2026-10-04T20:16:57Z

Cua Driver 0.33.3

Summary

This release includes 3 fixes.

Fixes

  • settle started browser consent before claim completion. (#4595)
  • drain committed consent work through timeout. (#4595)
  • refuse set_value on Finder's Get Info Name field. (#4614) Thanks @Ed-Key.

Contributors

Thanks to @Ed-Key for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-hyprland-kit-v1.3.0-omarchy-edge-20261004Hyprland build kit 1.3.0: Omarchy Edge x86_64 Stable2026-10-04T16:19:54Z

Hyprland build kit for Omarchy Edge x86_64

This kit rebuilds the optional Cua Hyprland plugin from Driver 0.33.2 against the measured omarchy-edge-20261004 profile. It contains source, packaging tools, checksums and provenance. It is not a prebuilt or Omarchy-signed plugin package.

  • Source and tooling: c82d32e3e1adbc6578a148962002ddf6e3e8a15a, the cua-driver-rs-v0.33.2 tag.
  • Environment: Hyprland 0.56.2-4, GCC 16.2.1 20260810, Mesa 1:26.2.4-1, plus the exact compositor, header, compiler and runtime identities in the profile.
  • Supported pairing: a plugin built from this kit with Cua Driver 0.33.2, input protocol 3, and native Wayland Inkscape 1.4.4-6 for background input.
  • Qualification: the package built from this kit (0.33.2-2) passed the isolated lifecycle, live install over and rollback to Omarchy's 0.32.0-3, reboot, the production smoke and two-lane proof with the published Driver, and the complete native Linux runner. QUALIFICATION.md lists every digest and limit. The full record is in #4395.

Verify the archive against its published SHA-256, and review PROFILE.json and KIT-PROVENANCE.json before building. Keep the KIT-PROVENANCE.json digest, e1c1653045149af9e1fba077a5bd91008c3178a180e62ac06dac9f19c6db5fbe, for the consumer check. Its provenance intentionally makes no native-certification claim; the evidence is recorded separately.

Omarchy owns Omabot replay, package maintenance and signing, and channel promotion. This release does not put a package into Omarchy's repositories.

  • fix: skip host-injected contextual fragments when deriving session titles (#2118) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/2119
  • docs: mirror missing Codex sections into CLIENTS.zh-CN.md (#2136) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/2137

Installation (release candidate)

This is a prerelease for validation. The stable install channels — Homebrew, the install.sh / install.ps1 scripts, npm, and PyPI — intentionally keep serving the latest stable release, so they will not install this RC. Use one of the methods below.

Manual download (recommended): Download the archive for your platform from the Assets below, extract it, and place bd on your PATH.

go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.3.2-rc.1
# For embedded Dolt support:
CGO_ENABLED=1 GOFLAGS=-tags=gms_pure_go go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.3.2-rc.1

thedotmack/claude-mem ↗ 3 releases · 3 stable
v13.31.0 Stable2026-10-05T05:17:54Z

Sessions start without waiting

A new session no longer waits on SQLite reading a project's whole history, or on cloud sync. On a 1.2 GB database the claude-mem SessionStart hook took about 3 seconds (up to 44 s at worst). The queries behind it now read a few hundred pages instead of tens of thousands, the precomputed context file is used even with cloud sync on, and nothing at session start waits on the network.

Performance

  • Newest memories come straight from an index. SessionStart used to fetch every observation and summary in the project, including worktrees merged into it, and sort them all to keep the newest 50. On the database we measured that was about 21,700 rows (63 MB) per session start, and 0.8–1.7 s whenever those pages were not in memory. New indexes keyed on project and date (schema v63) let it read the newest rows for each project key and stop. The results are identical, and the query takes about 4 ms. (#4427)
  • Project-alias lookups no longer load rows. Every context render resolves which stored project keys belong to the checkout. That lookup loaded each merged row just to read its project name: 7,499 pages for 31 keys. Covering indexes (schema v64) answer it from the index: 355 pages, 9 ms. (#4429)
  • Local first with cloud sync on. The worker builds SessionStart context from the local database straight away. The pull from the sync hub still runs, but in the background, so a slow or unreachable hub never delays a session. The precomputed SessionStart context file no longer waits for a Realtime connection: the local database is the source of truth, and every change sync applies refreshes the file. (#4427)
  • Cowork plugin skips the cloud read when claude-mem is installed locally. The claude-mem-cowork hook no longer fetches context from cmem.ai, at session start or for agent prompts, on a machine where the local claude-mem hook already injects it. Cowork's cloud containers still read from cmem.ai. (#4427)

Features

  • iFlytek Spark preset for the OpenAI-compatible provider (Astron MaaS, default model spark-x2.5). (#4379)

Fixes

  • Cloud sync no longer retries before the server's Retry-After minimum after jitter. (#4383)
  • Full-text search: an interrupted FTS capability probe, or one seen from another connection, no longer turns off full-text search. (#4385)
  • Field compression keeps the observation's context. (#4403)
  • Streams: an interrupted SSE response, or a rejected early-stop cancellation, no longer leaves its stream locked (#4382). SSE clients are removed when Bun closes their socket (#4394).
  • Logs: a log over 10 MiB with no newlines no longer makes the tail reader loop forever and block the worker. (#4393)
  • Viewer: a failed pagination request releases the loading state and shows the error. (#4387)
  • Parser: array entries that decode to whitespace are dropped instead of stored as blank facts. (#4397)
  • Smart file outlines keep multiline imports (#4409), assign methods to the right class (#4406), and include generator functions (#4419).

View release →

v13.30.1 Stable2026-10-05T04:37:56Z

Continue and resume preserve the restored conversation

Claude Code --continue, --resume, and /resume no longer print or inject a fresh claude-mem timeline into a conversation that is being restored. Reinjecting newly rendered startup context changed the conversation's prompt prefix and disrupted prompt-cache reuse. This patch keeps the existing conversation context intact while retaining worker startup and memory capture. (#4423)

Fixes

  • Skip timeline injection on resume. Worker startup and context injection now have separate SessionStart matchers. Resume still starts the worker asynchronously, while only startup, clear, and compact run the synchronous timeline hook.
  • Honor the session source throughout the hook. The Claude Code adapter preserves the SessionStart source, and the context handler returns an empty context block for resume before accessing project settings, cached timelines, the local worker, or the shared server. This also covers older hook registrations that still invoke the context handler on resume.
  • Suppress both copies of the timeline. Resumed conversations receive neither fresh timeline context nor a terminal timeline, including when cached model and colored timelines already exist or terminal output is enabled.
  • Keep context injection where it is needed. New sessions, clear, and compact retain model and terminal context. The resume guard applies to Claude Code; Codex context behavior is unchanged.

Validation

  • 266 focused tests passed across SessionStart adapters and matchers, context handlers, cached timelines, server runtime, distribution, hook lifecycle, and related context handling.
  • All eight CI checks passed on the fix, including Linux and Windows builds, Chroma lifecycle checks, sync services, clean-room dependency checks, and server runtime integration tests.
  • Build, TypeScript, and hook I/O checks passed. The rebuilt worker bundle was checked directly: a Claude Code resume returns empty SessionStart context with no timeline.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v13.30.0...v13.30.1

View release →

v13.30.0 Stable2026-10-04T22:45:28Z

Hooks stop waiting on the worker, and the observer costs less

Claude Code no longer waits on the claude-mem worker in the middle of a session: hooks save each event to disk and return at once, and SessionStart reads context the worker prepared ahead of time. The observer that writes your memories also costs less. A user prompt no longer gets a model call of its own, the observer's prompts now start with the same fixed instructions so provider prompt caches can reuse them, OpenRouter requests carry session and trace labels that keep a session on the provider holding its cache, observer thinking on the Claude path is really off, and a slow reply is waited for instead of being paid for twice. The release also fixes search, file context, hooks, the CLI, very large transcripts, and sign-in on Linux and Windows.

Features

  • Hooks save and return. The observation, file-edit, Stop and SessionEnd hooks write each event to a file under ~/.claude-mem/state/hook-spool/ and exit, without waiting on the worker or starting it. The worker picks the files up within moments, and an event delivered twice replaces its file instead of being stored twice. Files still unprocessed after 7 days move to hook-spool/expired/ and are logged. This replaces the SessionEnd replay queue. (#4368)
  • SessionStart context is ready before you start. The worker prepares SessionStart context in ~/.claude-mem/state/context-cache/, refreshing it about 2 seconds after anything that could change it, so a new session reads a file instead of waiting on the worker or on a cloud pull of up to 1.5 seconds. A missing or stale (over 24 hours old) file, or a context showing an observer or sync health notice, falls back to the live path. With cloud sync on, the file is used only while live updates are connected and caught up, so a memory deleted on another device is never served from it. (#4368, #4370)
  • Observer prompts that providers can cache. A provider's prompt cache (OpenRouter's, or the cmem.ai gateway's) can only reuse the part of a prompt that starts exactly as before. The observer's first and follow-up prompts now both open with the same block of fixed instructions, which depends only on the mode, followed by the session's context, the user's request and the follow-up text. In the code mode, two sessions' prompts now share their first ~7,260 characters, up from 422 (and from none between a first and a follow-up prompt). Only the order changed, plus one word ("below" became "above") in 33 modes, and the Claude SDK and Codex paths open the same way. (#4415)
  • Session and trace labels on OpenRouter requests. Observer requests that reach OpenRouter, directly or through the cmem.ai gateway, now include a session_id (a one-way SHA-256 hash of the Claude Code session id) and a trace with a random trace_id per observer conversation, trace_name claude-mem observer, a generation_name naming the request (init, observation, summary, field_compression or telegram_wrapup) and claude_mem_version. OpenRouter uses the session id to keep a session on the provider that holds its prompt cache, and OpenRouter Broadcast maps the labels to PostHog's $ai_session_id, $ai_trace_id and $ai_span_name. No path, project name or text you wrote is included, and custom base URLs and openai-compatible endpoints get neither field. (#4418)
  • One fewer observer call per prompt. A user prompt used to get an observer request of its own, which nearly always came back as "nothing to record": a full prompt for a nine-token reply. The prompt now goes out with the next observation or summary, in that event's single request, for the HTTP providers and the Claude SDK alike. Set CLAUDE_MEM_OBSERVE_BARE_PROMPTS=true (default false) to bring back the separate request. (#4336)
  • Slow replies are waited for, not paid for twice. OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible observer requests now stream behind the scenes, so a slow but working reply is kept alive by its progress (a 90-second idle limit and a 300-second cap) instead of being cut off at a fixed deadline and billed again. CLAUDE_MEM_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS now applies only to requests that do not stream: Gemini, Codex, the cmem.ai gateway, and an endpoint that rejects streaming, which is detected once and remembered. A paid request is resent only when the provider provably did no work (a 429 or a refusal before sending); each batch gets at most two paid sends, and a batch that uses them up is parked and logged, never silently dropped. (#4368)
  • Worker startup is reported, not guessed. The worker streams its startup phases (starting, db_ready, routes_ready, then ready or failed) at GET /api/ready. Hooks read that once instead of polling and assuming a worker is stuck once it has been up 300 seconds, and restarts are limited so a failure that repeats on every start cannot cause a restart loop. CLAUDE_MEM_WEDGED_WORKER_UPTIME_S now applies only to the launcher's port reclaim. (#4368)
  • Long knowledge-base calls stay alive. When the MCP client asks for it, corpus prime and query answer as a stream with a heartbeat every 10 seconds, so a long prime can run for up to 15 minutes instead of hitting a 30-second deadline, and the work stops if the client disconnects. (#4368)
  • Cloud sync live updates over Supabase Realtime. For cmem.ai Pro cloud sync, the worker gets live updates from a private Supabase Realtime channel instead of the sync hub's WebSocket and pulls whenever another device announces changes. A server without Realtime leaves the client polling, and CLAUDE_MEM_CLOUD_SYNC_WS=false still turns live updates off. (#4368)

Fixes

  • Observer thinking is really off on the Claude path. #3245 meant to turn it off but used an option name the Agent SDK ignores, so roughly 70% of the observer's output tokens on Claude Sonnet 4.5 went to thinking. The observer now passes the SDK's actual thinking option. (#4335)
  • Very large transcripts. The Stop hook reads a transcript backwards from the end in bounded chunks instead of loading the whole file. A transcript over 2 GB no longer fails with ENOMEM and loses the session summary, and a large one no longer costs hundreds of milliseconds and gigabytes of memory on every Stop: a 2.16 GB transcript now takes about 1 ms and 27 MB. (#4338)
  • Sign-in on Linux and Windows. claude-mem now reads ~/.claude/.credentials.json (or the one under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), where Claude Code keeps its login, before libsecret or Windows Credential Manager. A leftover Credential Manager entry from another account no longer hides the current login, libsecret is not queried on every observer start, and a libsecret miss no longer logs a misleading warning. A working CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN now wins over an expired stored login. macOS still checks the keychain first. (#4369)
  • "Invalid API key" false alarms. Only the Claude CLI's own invalid-key status line counts as a bad key, so an observer reply that quotes the phrase is no longer treated as an authentication failure. (#4337)
  • Worker start on Linux after an unclean shutdown. An older PID file without a start token is trusted only if that process really is the worker, so a PID reused by another program no longer blocks the worker from starting. (#4349)
  • Search. Underscores and percent signs in file names now match literally instead of acting as wildcards (#4354). Folder search and folder CLAUDE.md generation filter to a folder's direct children before paging, so files deeper down no longer crowd out the folder's own files, and the next page no longer repeats ones already shown (#4361). /api/search/observations now respects projects for Chroma results too, instead of returning observations from every project (#4367).
  • File context. Observations from a worktree that was merged into its parent project now appear in file context (#4351). XML character references in observer output are decoded, so a file written as src/A&amp;B.ts is stored and found as src/A&B.ts, and titles, facts and summaries no longer keep escape codes (#4360). A shell read that uses --, such as cat -- -notes.md, is now recognized (#4357).
  • Hook input. Hooks decode their input as UTF-8 across reads, so a character split between two reads (Japanese text, emoji) is no longer stored as replacement characters. (#4356)
  • CLI. claude-mem search uses the configured worker address, including a host or port saved in settings.json and IPv6 hosts such as ::1 (#4362). Folder CLAUDE.md generation handles tracked folders with non-ASCII names and file names that contain newlines (#4355).
  • Transcript watcher. A transcript-watch.json config or state file saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark, as some Windows editors and PowerShell do, now loads in the watcher and in the Codex and Grok Bot installers, instead of failing or silently resetting read positions and replaying transcripts. (#4352)
  • Memory edits through the API. PATCH /v1/memories/:id keeps the fields you leave out and clears a field you set to null, instead of resetting omitted fields to their defaults. An edit that would leave a memory with no searchable text is rejected with a 400. (#4353)

Internal changes

  • Cloud sync server. The sync server no longer scans a user's whole change history on every pull, pulls and status checks no longer take a per-user lock, /health no longer touches the database, and database sessions get statement, lock and idle-transaction timeouts, passed in a form Neon honors. Together these stop the lock pile-ups that took the only sync machine out of service. A new FORWARD_ORIGIN mode forwards sync traffic to the Supabase cmem-sync function for the move to Supabase. (#4347, #4368)
  • Request ids and error bodies. HTTP observer requests carry a per-batch x-client-request-id in place of the unused x-claude-mem-prior-request-id, and error bodies are read up to 64 KiB. (#4368)
  • Tests and docs. A two-device cloud sync end-to-end matrix against Supabase, coverage for the v21 schema repair alongside the v41 origin index, and fixes for leaks and races in the full test suite (#4350, #4368). The cloud sync, configuration and OpenAI-compatible provider docs are updated.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v13.29.0...v13.30.0

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 prerelease
v4.0.1CC Switch v4.0.1 Prerelease2026-10-05T05:09:53Z

CC Switch v4.0.1

4.0 预览版的第一个修复版本

感谢大家对 4.0 预览版的试用和反馈。这个版本修复了 Gemini CLI 会话读不到、WSL 下 Codex 启动变慢等问题，也让 OpenCode 能用上思考档位。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

预览版不会自动更新。 应用内更新只跟随正式版，已经装了 4.0.0 的话，请在本页手动下载 4.0.1 安装。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

OpenCode 可以选择思考档位了。 OpenCode 只会给标记为「支持推理」的模型提供思考档位（Ctrl+T），而 CC Switch 写入的自定义供应商以前从不带这个标记，所以通过 CC Switch 添加的模型一直选不了档位。现在，预设和获取到的模型只要已知支持推理（以预设或 models.dev 为准），就会自动标记，档位由 OpenCode 自己生成，跟随 OpenCode 的版本更新。

「跳过 Claude Code 初次安装确认」有了说明。 点开这一项的帮助图标，可以看到开关具体做了什么：在 ~/.claude.json 里写入或删除 hasCompletedOnboarding。

修复

  • 会话管理读不到 Gemini CLI 的会话。 新版 Gemini CLI 把会话记录改成了 JSONL 格式，并会在恢复会话时把旧文件迁移过去，导致会话页看不到 Gemini 会话，用量同步也导入不到数据。现在完整支持新格式；旧文件和迁移后的新文件同时存在时只显示一份，删除时一起删掉。会话标题也会跳过 CLI 自动注入的上下文和斜杠命令。
  • WSL 下的 Codex 拖慢启动和会话扫描。 Codex 配置目录放在 WSL 里时，Windows 无法给其中的 SQLite 数据库加锁，每次都要等 5 秒超时。历史迁移因此每次启动都重来一遍，扫描会话也会卡住。现在会跳过这类数据库，会话标题改从会话索引读取。
  • 上游拒绝请求，却被报成「输出达到上限」。 有些 Responses 上游（比如 ChatGPT Codex 后端拒绝某个工具定义时）会在不处理请求的情况下返回「输出 token 达到上限」，用量全是 0，Claude Code 就提示了一个根本没碰到的上限。现在这种情况会如实报告为上游错误，并带上拒绝原因。
  • Codex 用量同步可能卡死。 一个无关的异常之后，同步带父会话的 Codex 记录时可能卡住不动，现在已修复。
  • Grok Build 的「获取 API Key」打开的是官网首页。 现在和其他应用一样，打开预设提供的注册页面。

体验改进

  • 侧边栏收起和展开更流畅。 动画改由合成层绘制，跟随屏幕刷新率，不再受限于 WebView 主线程的 60 帧。中途反向点击会从当前位置接着走。
  • 侧边栏底部分隔线和上方的分隔线样式统一，选中「用量统计」时不再贴着线。
  • 重置次数的下拉箭头单独占一行时，和上一行的倒计时时钟对齐。

构建与发布

macOS 两个架构改为并行编译，公证失败重试时不必从头编译；任何一个平台缺少更新签名时，构建会直接失败，不会再发布一个缺了某个平台的更新清单。

致谢

感谢 @allenxu09（Gemini CLI 会话、侧边栏动画与分隔线）和 @parkavenue9639（上游拒绝的错误报告）的贡献，感谢 @juntaosun 第一时间报告 Gemini CLI 会话的问题。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。

tw93/Pake ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
V3.17.3V3.17.3 Tide Stable2026-10-05T04:39:57Z

<div align="center"> <img src="https://gw.alipayobjects.com/zos/k/fa/logo-modified.png" alt="Pake Logo" width="120" height="120" style="border-radius:50%" /> <h1 style="margin: 12px 0 6px;">Pake V3.17.3</h1> <p><em>Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.</em></p> </div>

Changelog

  1. Native capabilities such as notifications, downloads, zoom, window controls, and opening links in the system browser are now granted only to local pages and the exact origin of the packaged URL, so a page that navigates to another site can no longer call them. Package the final URL a site lands on, for example https://mail.google.com rather than https://gmail.com.
  2. Clicking a notification on macOS brings back the window that sent it and removes it from Notification Center, and with --multi-window a message raised by several windows is shown once and counted once on the Dock badge.
  3. Downloads send the page's User-Agent, Referer, and session cookies, including after redirects, so files behind a login save correctly. A failed download no longer leaves a truncated file, and simultaneous downloads with the same name are saved separately.
  4. Linux apps default to a User-Agent that matches their WebKit engine instead of claiming to be Chrome, which lets YouTube captions load. --user-agent still overrides it.
  5. Linux apps follow the desktop's light or dark preference and switch live when it changes, while --dark-mode still takes priority.
  6. On macOS, window.print() opens the print dialog, two-finger trackpad swipes go back and forward, and the tab bar shows a + button when --multi-window is on.
  7. Windows adds the opt-in --password-autosave, which offers to save passwords in the app's own WebView2 profile and stays off in private windows. --windows-toolchain gnu --keep-binary now places WebView2Loader.dll beside the executable so it starts on its own.

更新日志

  1. 通知、下载、缩放、窗口控制和用系统浏览器打开链接这些原生能力，现在只开放给本地页面和打包网址的精确来源，页面跳到其他站点后就无法再调用，打包时要用网站最终打开的网址，比如 https://mail.google.com 而不是 https://gmail.com。
  2. macOS 上点击通知会唤回发出它的窗口并从通知中心移除，开启 --multi-window 时多个窗口收到的同一条消息只弹一次，程序坞角标也只加一次。
  3. 下载会带上页面的 User-Agent、Referer 和登录 Cookie，跳转之后也不会丢，需要登录的文件可以正常保存，下载失败不再留下不完整的文件，同名文件同时下载时也会分别保存。
  4. Linux 应用默认使用与 WebKit 引擎一致的 User-Agent，不再自称 Chrome，YouTube 字幕因此可以正常加载，--user-agent 依然可以覆盖。
  5. Linux 应用会跟随桌面的浅色或深色偏好，运行中切换也会实时生效，--dark-mode 仍然优先。
  6. macOS 上 window.print() 可以弹出打印面板，触控板双指左右滑动可以前进和后退，开启 --multi-window 时标签栏会显示 + 按钮。
  7. Windows 新增可选的 --password-autosave，开启后应用会在自己的 WebView2 配置里提示保存密码，隐私窗口中始终关闭，--windows-toolchain gnu --keep-binary 也会把 WebView2Loader.dll 放在可执行文件旁边，程序可以直接启动。

Special thanks to @Yaman-Harfoush, @nhanntgit, @karl007, and @BenzidaneMo for the detailed reports, and to @yhcharles, @davidscottpope-gif, @WavesMan, @BenzidaneMo, and @jakero for the pull requests behind this release. If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends.

Code mode can install JavaScript packages per session. 5.1.19 runs on senpi 2026.10.10. A cell that is only %bun add <package ...> or %npm add <package ...> installs packages into the session's own managed environment without restarting the kernel, and the next cell imports them. The project's package.json and node_modules are untouched and package scripts never run. (senpi 2026.10.10)

Added

A Python cell's @tool functions can be granted to a task child, the same way JavaScript tool(fn) tools already were. (#9529)

Changed

An idle gateway store gives back its worker thread. After 60 seconds with no store call in flight, the worker is retired, and the next call starts a fresh one with its registrations restored. That frees about 2.9 MB per terminal control endpoint. (#9592)

omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10. It warns when a requested thinking level isn't available instead of dropping it, keeps project rule discovery inside the project on Windows, and keeps the resident Claude subscription session receiving only new messages when compaction.model is set. Code mode also gets opt-in isolated cells (isolate: true with sandbox.enabled). Full list: senpi 2026.10.10.

v5.1.18 Stable2026-10-04T23:29:48Z

omo models discover, omo schedule and the other one-shot engine commands run again instead of opening the TUI. 5.1.18 runs on senpi 2026.10.9. The launcher passed only a fixed list of commands straight to the engine and put --extension <plugin> in front of everything else, so the engine never saw its own command and started an interactive session with the arguments. Every engine command is now handed over unchanged. Thanks to @ushion0a for the report and the repro. (#9572, #9573)

Fixed

omo holds every Bun to the 1.4 floor the engine needs. A bun add -g install, or OMO_RUNTIME=bun, ran under whatever Bun it found, so on Bun 1.3.x /computer on failed with No such built-in module: node:sqlite. Now a Bun you chose that is older than 1.4 stops at startup and says to run bun upgrade; an older Bun nobody chose hands off to Node, as other installs already did. (#9563, #9564)

A task child that has its own fallback models falls back through them on the shared task host. Its category's or agent's chain used to be ignored there, so a child whose model hit a limit failed even with a chain configured. Children without fallback models behave as before. On a host that can't carry the chain (an older engine, or the per-child process runner) the child runs as today and you are warned once instead of losing the chain silently. (#9512, #9518)

An empty /tasks answer says when other sessions have tasks and that /tasks --all lists them. Thanks to @cynkai. (#9569, #9588)

The ulw-plan skill names only delegation categories that exist. It listed git and the retired deep, so a plan following it delegated to a category the session didn't have. Thanks to @DevNewbie1826 for the report. (#9561, #9565)

Added

Code mode's wait() and handle() work on omo's own task children and workpools, not only on engine runs. (#9541)

Changed

omo runs on senpi 2026.10.9. A permission prompt sent to an app names the tool call it approves, so each prompt shows its own call's input; a reply that only answers a question is just the answer, never wrapped in a quote; code mode gets Python agent(prompt, tools=[...]), cell-defined tools for workpool, %load <path> and %pip install without a kernel restart. Full list: senpi 2026.10.9.

/memfs maintenance commands load on first use, which trims the plugin bundle by about 8 KB; their output is unchanged. Thanks to @Dante-dan. (#9526)

Thanks also to @Dante-dan (#9575, #9579) and @MoerAI (#9589) for test and release-pipeline fixes.

v5.1.17 Stable2026-10-04T16:31:47Z

An idle engine host now exits after its idle window once its sessions are done. 5.1.17 runs on senpi 2026.10.8. Before, a host counted a session busy on every agent_start but cleared it only once per run, so any run that retried, continued after compaction or took a follow-up left the host busy forever and it never exited; a session closed mid-run did the same. The host now tracks runs and drops a session when it closes. Thanks to @DevNewbie1826 for the report. (senpi#2713, senpi#2717)

Fixed

A workpool create that reuses a pool name no longer inherits that pool's tools. A second workpool create with the same name from the same session got the first pool, and the tools it was granted, even when it asked for different tools or none. Now a pool is reused only when the tools asked for match its grant; any other grant is refused as a name conflict. (#9548)

Replies no longer come back formatted as a quote. Several bundled prompts showed their reply-format examples (handoff templates, the routing line) as markdown quote lines, and the model copied the > into its answer, so whole replies rendered as blockquotes. The examples are now plain lines; the wording is unchanged. (#9538, #9550)

A cold Python start on a busy machine no longer fails as a hang. The Python kernel counts CPU use and output during startup as progress, with an absolute ceiling, instead of failing after a fixed silent window. (senpi#2718, #9495)

On Windows, memory reflection works again instead of parking itself. A failed reflection on Windows was recorded as "refused by its provider", so automatic reflection parked after a few runs and stopped saving facts. A build with this fix un-parks on its next successful reflection; run /reflect to trigger one now, and use /facts retry for facts that were parked while it was stuck. (#9553, #9554)

Changed

omo runs on senpi 2026.10.8. The bundled Claude Agent SDK moves to 0.3.289 (Claude Code 2.1.289); continue_from_leaf acknowledges when the continued turn starts, so a long desktop continuation no longer times out; code mode gets Python kernel tools beside a parked cell. Full list: senpi 2026.10.8.

omo can now inject a chat gateway scope's operating rules into bound sessions as one block in the system prompt; it takes effect once the gateway connector that pushes them ships. Every other session's prompt is unchanged. (#9540)

longbridge/gpui-kit ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.7.1GPUI Kit v0.7.1 Stable2026-10-05T02:36:42Z

GPUI Kit v0.7.1

GPUI Kit v0.7.1 adds speech input and ColorSelect, and gives charts an initial draw-in animation. It improves IME editing, inline-token interactions, Markdown source mapping and streaming, keyboard focus, and table rendering. This release pins the GPUI snapshot dependencies to 0.3.8.

New components and charts

  • Speech input: enable the speech feature to capture audio with SpeechState, start and stop sessions with SpeechButton, and display levels with SpeechWaveform. Applications can supply a SpeechRecognizer and AudioInput; native system recognition is available on supported macOS and Windows configurations, while Linux needs an application recognizer. (#3333)
  • Speech waveform: levels are sampled once per 80 ms, and the waveform starts empty and scrolls smoothly from the trailing edge using its own playhead. (#3352)
  • ColorSelect: use a framed color field with a swatch, hex value and caret in forms. ColorSelect::new shares ColorPickerState with the compact picker, and supports placeholder and accessible-name overrides. ColorPicker now applies its root style refinements. (#3289)
  • Chart appear motion: built-in charts draw their data in on first paint, with reduced-motion support. Use .appear(false) to opt out or .appear_key(...) to replay; PlotAppearScope remembers completed animations across virtual-list remounts while the scope remains painted. Existing custom plots retain their behavior unless they opt in. (#3296, #3308)

Editor and text input

  • Inline-token hover: Input::on_token_hover and Textarea::on_token_hover report token entry and exit with InlineTokenHoverEvent, so applications can anchor tooltips or previews without changing selection. JavaScript bindings expose the same interaction. (#3346)
  • Fixed IME candidate positioning before repaint and grouped rewrites of a typed character, including Korean IME input, into the typing undo step. (#3297, #3341)
  • Fixed Textarea row-based height, text clipping in short single-line frames, and consistency between soft wrapping and horizontal scrolling. (#3330, #3343, #3358)
  • Fixed completion-prefix measurement and stale trigger offsets, Kotlin syntax-query compilation, and stale syntax-injection ranges. (#3363, #3367, #3317)
  • Fixed mask validation for non-ASCII characters, including Chinese literal separators and characters matched by *. (#3369)

Markdown and text rendering

  • Source-based highlights: RenderedText::source exposes the source of the rendered snapshot, and range_for_source converts Markdown source byte ranges into rendered ranges for RangeHighlight. (#3281)
  • Scrollable code blocks: a code-block style with vertical scrolling and a height cap now provides its own scrollbar, handles nested wheel scrolling and keeps code actions pinned. (#3322)
  • Improved streaming through incremental prefix updates in TextViewState::set_text and by committing valid background parse results overtaken by newer chunks. (#3294, #3344)
  • Fixed CJK punctuation wrapping, inherited text colors in filled containers, and ragged GFM table rows; scroll-table column measurements are reused. (#3293, #3329, #3365, #3318)

Dock and controls

  • Dock: DockArea::set_split_sizes restores a split's proportions in place, without rebuilding panels, and reports one layout change. (#3314)
  • Questionnaire: choosing a single-choice answer now confirms the item and advances or submits after a brief feedback pause. QuestionnaireState::choose exposes that activation path; activate_choice continues to change the answer without confirming. Arrow-key selection, multiple-choice toggles and freeform typing do not auto-advance. (#3350)
  • Keyboard focus: borderless buttons show a legible focus line, DataTable shows keyboard focus, and popup menus preserve a single keyboard highlight. (#3299, #3300, #3307)
  • Control sizing: control text follows the Input/Select size ladder, OtpInput follows interface zoom, and Large Switch uses a larger track. (#3287)
  • Clipboard: buttons have a localized accessible name by default; accessibility_label provides a contextual override. (#3354)
  • Slider: touch drags on the track move the thumb. (#3313)
  • Radio: disabled controls stay disabled inside RadioGroup. (#3331)
  • Shimmer: the default highlight remains visible on foreground text in dark mode. (#3328)
  • Command: item-row corners stay concentric with the frame. (#3285)

Runtime, platform and documentation

  • GPUI snapshot: exact snapshot dependencies are updated to =0.3.8, with continuation-indent API adaptation preserving the previous wrapping behavior. (#3370)

  • Web runtime: target-specific Instant handling avoids a touch-related wasm panic. (#3271)

  • Scrolling: phaseless mouse wheels continue scrolling after an edge bounce. (#3316)

  • Shell: QuickJS JIT is updated to 0.12.11. (#3338)

  • Kit macros: the hidden GPUI re-export points at Kit, keeping generated paths consistent. (#3306)

  • Documentation: release snapshots drive onboarding dependency versions; setup documents the macOS font-kit requirement, and skill examples correct app startup, async and Select re-entrancy usage. (#3284, #3356, #3339, #3345, #3351)

Behavior changes

Charts animate on first paint by default; disable this with .appear(false). Non-interactive built-in charts now retain an element ID for animation and caches, while remaining non-interactive. (#3296)

  let chart = LineChart::new(data).interactive(false);
- assert!(Plot::id(&chart).is_none());
+ assert!(Plot::id(&chart).is_some());
+ assert!(!Plot::interactive(&chart));

Single-choice Questionnaire activation now confirms by default. Applications that need to change an answer without confirmation can continue to call activate_choice. (#3350)

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!

1jehuang/jcode ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.90.1 Stable2026-10-05T02:11:55Z

Provider reliability and fixes

Highlights

  • OpenAI-compatible providers that answer 529 or another 5xx "heavy usage" error are now retried automatically instead of failing the turn, and the error no longer blames your network
  • /usage shows real quota windows for Kimi Code, Cursor, and the Z.ai Coding Plan (thanks @ghoker143)
  • Pressing Esc while a follow-up prompt is pending stops the current turn and runs the follow-up (thanks @SiavZ)

Improvements

  • Copilot accepts reasoning effort for every model whose catalog advertises it and sends it on both the Responses and Chat Completions APIs
  • Saved API keys stay in their env files instead of the running process, so editing a key file takes effect without a restart
  • The client shows the context window the server resolved instead of a placeholder
  • The jcode log records which binary actually launched, to diagnose stale copies on PATH
  • Gmail can update, list, and delete drafts
  • Undo in the composer reverts a whole typing burst at once, including Korean and other IME input (thanks @mg-mg-mg)
  • Cost estimates for OpenAI-compatible profiles fall back to a matching model from another provider's price catalog (thanks @ogodevonline)
  • Edit tool rows show their intent, and the expand badge appears in every diff mode

Fixes

  • DeepSeek enabled through --provider auto uses its own default model and 1M context instead of anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 with 200K
  • In-app updates on Termux patch the glibc ELF interpreter like the installer does, and refuse to switch to a binary that cannot run
  • Configured /colors roles now apply on 256-color terminals
  • Images in formats providers reject are no longer stored or sent, and sessions self-heal from the resulting 400 errors
  • Session saves are drained on SIGTERM, and an interrupted checkpoint can no longer duplicate history
  • Anthropic history repair: orphaned or late tool results and orphaned native web searches no longer cause request errors
  • Malformed tool calls are corrected within a bounded number of retries instead of looping
  • Auto-poke re-arms when new open work appears after the completion gate trips
  • /accounting is no longer parsed as /account
  • The crash detector no longer reports a session that closed while idle as interrupted (thanks @SK-DEV-AI)

Full changelog: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.90.0...v0.90.1

studio-v2.28.0Reasonix Studio v2.28.0 Prerelease2026-10-05T00:51:38Z

本版是第一个同时发布命令行 reasonix 的 Studio 版本：终端界面补齐 1.x 的常用命令并换上 2.x 内核，同时加固权限规则、插件安装与凭据显示，并新增提交说明草拟、用量日历范围和复制会话信息。

新增

  • 命令行：本版起 reasonix 命令行随 Studio 一同发布，1.x 的命令行迁移到 2.x 内核，迁移差异见 docs/MIGRATING.md (#11968, #11920)
  • 终端界面：/model、/provider 打开可搜索的选择面板并切换当前会话，也可带参数直接切换；选择只对当前会话生效 (#11929)
  • 终端界面：/skills 打开面板，可搜索、按来源筛选，空格标记后按回车批量启停技能 (#11934)
  • 终端界面：/mcp 打开管理面板，可启停、重连并查看 MCP 服务；启用仓库自带的服务前会先显示脱敏后的启动命令并要求确认 (#11935)
  • 终端界面：/remote、/preset（别名 /work-mode、/profile）和 /paste-image 不再提示未知命令 (#11937)
  • 终端界面：底栏和每轮回执标出本次花费按高峰还是低谷价计费；只在按厂商官方时段定价时显示 (#11936)
  • 终端界面：没有可用密钥时发送消息会在本地拒绝并说明原因，不再发给服务商换回 401 (#11928)
  • 工作台的「更改」列表新增「提交…」：根据已暂存的差异草拟提交说明，可编辑，确认后只做本地提交，不推送 (#11534)
  • 暂存内容含疑似密钥文件时，提交前需勾选确认；这类文件的差异不会发给模型 (#11534)
  • 设置的用量页支持自定义日期范围和按自然月查看，并新增每日明细表，触屏上也能读到每天的确切用量 (#11665 by @Harbor404)
  • 用量图按配置的服务商显示名称，并为各服务商使用固定的颜色 (#11665 by @Harbor404)
  • 设置的用量页新增费用显示币种（自动、人民币、美元），/currency 切换后各面板立即跟随 (#11950)
  • 会话右键菜单新增「复制会话信息」，复制会话 ID、上下文目录、任务目录和会话记录文件路径 (#11667 by @Harbor404)
  • 智谱 GLM-5.2 提供 auto、none、minimal 到 max 的思考强度档位，GLM-5.3 提供 auto、low、high、max，所选档位会发给服务商 (#11342 by @par73e)
  • 未改动过的内置智谱预设会补上 GLM-5.3 和 GLM-5.3-Flash；自己调整过的模型列表不受影响 (#11342 by @par73e)
  • 自动语言模式下，用户用中文提问时，可见回答也会被要求使用中文，不再出现中文思考、英文回答 (#11953)
  • 新增可安装的离线回显服务商示例，无需密钥即可完整跑通一轮对话，供扩展作者参考 (#11839 by @KHG420)

变更

  • 在会话里切换模型不再改写配置里的 default_model，新会话和下次启动仍用原来的默认模型；设置里的「默认模型」和首次启动的选择仍会保存 (#11897)
  • 应用窗口的刷新快捷键改为 Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R；F5 和 Ctrl/Cmd+R 留给页面，在内置浏览器里只刷新当前页 (#11908)
  • 保存的密钥现在逐字节原样读回：用引号包起来输入的密钥会连引号一起保存，${HOME} 之类不再被展开 (#11923)
  • 无法安全存储的密钥值会在写入前被拒绝，并提示原因，不会让整份凭据文件失效 (#11923)
  • 终端界面：未知的 /xxx 命令作为普通消息发给模型，并显示一行提示，与 1.x 一致 (#11969)
  • 终端界面：/status 补上工作区分支行、思考强度和模型引用，与 1.x 一致 (#11924)
  • 终端界面：/rename <序号> <标题> 命名指定的已保存会话，恢复选择器也显示自定义名称 (#11926)
  • 终端界面：待办全部完成后继续显示，直到下一轮开始 (#11933)
  • 终端界面：只有空白内容的思考块不再画出「thought for 0s」标记 (#11930)
  • 保存设置时运行时正忙，现在提示「已保存，等本轮结束后生效」，不再显示成重建失败 (#11911)
  • 服务商编辑表单区分保存失败和已保存但尚未生效，两者用不同标题和颜色 (#11939)
  • 添加或测试服务商时，如果只有 /v1/models 能应答，保存的地址会自动补全为带 /v1 的地址，聊天请求不再打到错误的路径 (#11909)
  • 单个模型检查被拒绝时，显示 HTTP 状态码和服务端返回的说明，其中密钥已被遮蔽 (#11990)
  • 同一地址上、使用不同密钥的两个服务商，其模型现在都会出现在模型列表里，不再被当成重复项丢掉 (#12006)
  • 手动压缩和自动压缩失败时，提示会用当前界面语言给出具体原因，取消、忙碌和未分类的失败也有说明 (#11975)
  • 压缩摘要请求改为使用服务商允许的较低思考强度，减少摘要被思考耗尽输出而丢弃；DeepSeek pro 没有低档，不受影响，仍可能被截断 (#11972)
  • 摘要因超时、失败或截断而失败后，输入增长到一定量会再次尝试自动压缩，不再整段对话都不再重试 (#11973)

修复

  • Windows 上会话里第一次执行删除命令时，PowerShell 解析器冷启动较慢，不再因此被拒绝 (#11895)
  • Windows 开始菜单里的应用图标铺满图标格，与相邻图标大小一致；已安装或已固定的图标需等系统刷新图标缓存 (#11925)
  • 点开一个被窗格打开的历史版本，侧栏里不再同时出现两行同一份记录，也不会同时弹出两个删除确认 (#11914)
  • 第一轮对话所在的文件夹会被记住，之后启动到别的文件夹时，侧栏仍能找到这些会话；已经丢失的需要重新添加该项目 (#11981)
  • 提交消息后输入框立即清空，不会被草稿恢复重新填回；取回排队消息时原文只恢复一次 (#11831)
  • 排队消息取回的竞态：连点不再误报「已发送，无法取回」，过期的队列刷新不会把已取回的消息放回面板，也不会留下幽灵行 (#11976)
  • 反馈对话框关闭再打开后，已附的截图会保留，发送成功后才清掉 (#11903)
  • 没有打开任何会话时点击反馈，会先启动会话再打开，不再毫无反应；云备份按钮不可用时会说明还差什么 (#11960)
  • 创建云备份时，已删除服务商遗留的私有密钥槽不再导致备份创建成功却无法预览恢复，旧备份也因此可以恢复 (#11964)
  • 设置的「恢复旧会话」可以从 1.x 的项目目录、sessions-v4 和桌面版会话目录导入，选错目录时会提示应选哪一个 (#11927)
  • 点击对话里的链接时，若页面在内置浏览器里加载失败，不再同时在系统浏览器里再打开一份 (#11982)
  • 没有兼容能力而被拒绝的市场安装预览，不再进入「确认安装」界面，而是显示错误并可重试 (#11806 by @KHG420)
  • 导出插件时，带字节序标记、UTF-16 或 GBK 编码的 JSON 文件也能正常导出，且仍会清除其中的凭据 (#11711 by @KHG420)
  • 插件代理清单的名称与运行时一致，同名代理只列出实际生效的一个，并说明被遮蔽的路径 (#11742 by @KHG420)
  • 插件的技能或代理声明被拒绝时，已安装列表和 plugin doctor 会给出原因，即使该插件已被停用；不显示被拒绝的字段值 (#11697 by @KHG420)
  • plugin doctor 检查插件运行时文件是否可执行，不可执行时报错退出，不再显示 ok (#11719 by @KHG420)
  • 通过 ACP 报告每个 MCP 服务的健康状态；尚未获启动批准的项目服务在列表里显示为待批准，开关保持关闭 (#11343 by @par73e)
  • 命令行归档里的 reasonix version --verbose 现在会显示提交号和构建时间，与 npm 包一致 (#11931)
  • 扩展 SDK：提供方流结束或取消时释放上下文，打开阶段的取消生效，拦截超时把读取外置内容的时间计算在内 (#11791 by @KHG420, #11795 by @KHG420, #11789 by @KHG420)
  • 扩展 SDK：提供方返回未注册的块类型、负的用量或空的工具调用标识时，流以失败结束，不再静默丢块 (#11837 by @KHG420, #11843 by @KHG420, #11844 by @KHG420)

升级须知

  • 命令行：在未信任的文件夹里，reasonix run 和 -p 拒绝了编辑或命令时退出码为 4（加 --fail-on-unverified 时为 3），不再返回 0；脚本需先 reasonix trust 或明确指定模式 (#11920)
  • 命令行：Shift+Tab 和 Ctrl+Y 进入 YOLO 立即生效，没有确认，与 1.x 一致；只有 --yolo 或 --permission-mode yolo 启动时会在首次询问一次 (#11968)
  • 命令行：默认模式是自动，沙盒能限制写入且文件夹受信任时生效，否则为询问；启动前仍会询问是否信任该文件夹 (#11968, #11920)
  • 命令行：/recover-context 和 /continue-checks 已退役，/web 不是斜杠命令，请在外壳里运行 reasonix web (#11968)
  • 安全：Bash 的拒绝和询问规则现在会穿透 env、sudo、doas、command、nohup、time、nice 等包装，再匹配实际运行的程序；无法确定目标时改为询问，规则不会因此放宽 (#12018)
  • 安全：远程安装的清单必须完整且有上限：超过 2 MiB 或服务器擅自返回部分内容都会被拒绝，单次下载最长 30 秒 (#11808 by @KHG420)
  • 安全：MCP 的地址、参数和诊断信息在所有显示、预览、导出和备份界面里统一遮蔽凭据；地址无法解析时整体隐藏；不含密钥的备份也会遮蔽这些内容 (#11816)
  • 安全：Studio 调用 git 时，会拒绝会运行程序或写文件的选项，例如 --upload-pack、--output、--ext-diff (#11906)
  • 安全：读取插件的代理清单只在插件包目录内进行，只读普通文件，并限制为 1 MiB；包外的路径不会被描述 (#11702 by @KHG420)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@Harbor404、@par73e、@KHG420

Graphify-Labs/graphify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.76 Stable2026-10-04T20:03:08Z

More language-structure coverage, resolution/dedup correctness, and a security fix for the git-hook installer.

  • Feature: four more language extractors gained type coverage from @rajatnagda45 — Zig tagged-union variants (union(enum)) emit a node per variant with a case_of edge (#4050), C++ union specifiers are extracted as class-like type nodes with their members (#4052), VB.NET enum members link via case_of instead of contains (which also stops a member named like a type binding as a constructor) (#4054), and Pascal enumerated types and their values are extracted (#4056).
  • Feature: three Scala type-reference fixes shipped together earlier in the day are followed here by @Faisal-Fayaz's extractor hardening — graphify now stops walking JSON Schema files as config manifests, keyed on a $schema declaration plus a structural marker ($defs/definitions/$id) so real manifests that merely reference a schema are unaffected (#4048, #2255).
  • Fix: Elixir import/use call scoping is now per-module rather than per-file, so an unqualified call in one module no longer resolves against another module's imports in the same file (#4058, refines #4015).
  • Fix: track calls to external Python modules — a module.func() call to a plainly-imported dependency now records a calls edge to that module, fail-closed (receiver-shadowing and non-unique bindings are skipped, builtins and unresolved locals are never fabricated) (#4043, #3793, thanks @oleksii-tumanov).
  • Fix: Svelte files now feed only their <script> blocks to the AST pass (masking the template and style, preserving line numbers), so the markup no longer produces a parse error that dropped every symbol (#3984, #3928, thanks @Agnik47).
  • Fix: PHP language constructs (isset, empty, list, eval, ...) no longer bind as calls to a user method that happens to share the name (#3975, #3830, thanks @Cintu07).
  • Fix: an unresolved base class whose only same-named definition lives in another language is kept unresolved instead of binding across languages; same-language cross-file inheritance still resolves (#4068, thanks @SrijanSriv).
  • Fix: unstamped document nodes with the same heading in different files are no longer merged together during dedup; same-file document twins still merge (#4065, thanks @SrijanSriv).
  • Fix: graphify path and the MCP shortest_path tool resolve a path::symbol or raw node-id endpoint to the exact node before falling back to fuzzy scoring, and refuse an ambiguous endpoint instead of silently picking one (#3935, #3913, thanks @bercedev).
  • Fix: cross-repo resolver confidence scores are snapped to the canonical INFERRED rubric (a label-only change; no edge is added, dropped, or reclassified) (#4046, #4045, thanks @DeepanshuPal).
  • Fix: graphify no longer indexes its own installed skill folders and whole-written rule/hook files when scanning a project, keyed on the exact install locations so a user's own graphify-named folder is not skipped (#4062, #4057, thanks @Mpasha17).
  • Fix: the suggested questions in the analysis output are diversified across signal types with a round-robin, so one category no longer crowds out the others (#3972, #3849, thanks @azizur100389).
  • Security: graphify hook install refuses a core.hooksPath that resolves outside the repository (resolving both sides, symlink-safe), falling back to the in-repo .git/hooks instead of writing an executable outside the checkout; legitimate in-repo custom hook paths, linked worktrees, and submodules still work (#3919, #3869, CWE-22, thanks @nothariharan).
  • Chore: the PyPI package page now points Homepage at graphify.com and adds a Documentation link to docs.graphify.com; Repository and Issues stay on GitHub (#4069, thanks @SyedFahad7).

tt-a1i/archify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
archify-dsh-v1.0.0Archify DSH 1.0.0 Stable2026-10-04T17:16:13Z

Archify DSH 1.0.0

@tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.0.0 brings the Archify 3.x authoring and delivery flow to the DeepSeek Harness community integration. It bundles Archify 3.0.1, including the post-tag Skill installation fix from #704, from immutable source 7158026e852f3aa6578c741e673b46d7878c92c1. Adapter and Archify version numbers are independent.

The supported host is exactly @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1, with Node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0. DSH remains a developer preview; the adapter's 1.0 contract does not promise compatibility with other host versions. This is a community integration, not an official DeepSeek product.

Install and upgrade

Update the DSH host separately to the supported version, then run this command in each profile that uses Archify:

dsh plugin --profile web add @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.0.0

The same command upgrades the previous plugin. Archify 3.x includes authored brand marks, Workflow schema v2, Viewer localization, and optional update awareness. Existing schema-v1 inputs remain supported; existing HTML retains its embedded Viewer. See the Archify 3.0 upgrade notes.

This release preserves the single archify-plugin filesystem Skill provider. It adds no native tools, runtime dependencies, lifecycle scripts, telemetry, credentials handling, or automatic plugin upgrades. The host evaluates the package's bounded cordis.patch.yml resolution expression outside the agent sandbox. Generated files remain ordinary workspace files, without automatic Web Produced Files chips.

The prepared adapter 0.2.0 was never published. Published 0.1.0 remains immutable; 1.0.0 supersedes that candidate.

Release validation

The release gate covers clean installation and integrity-pinned published plugin 0.1.0 → 1.0.0 upgrade in isolated profiles on Linux, macOS, and Windows. It checks installed bytes, single-provider discovery and Skill loading, installed CLI doctor and demo, uninstall, and preservation of the base profile. The full source-version smoke runs on a temporary copy to preserve pnpm store hard links.

Published on npm at 2026-10-04 17:10:03 UTC: @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.0.0. Public latest is 1.0.0. The registry tarball is byte-identical to the accepted-main build from 594f6087358610bd16e64e5602976020871b6bff.

  • Three-platform clean install and upgrade gate
  • Accepted main CI and DSH acceptance
  • Version-specific package guide

can1357/oh-my-pi ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v18.6.1 Stable2026-10-04T16:12:44Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed

  • Fixed native OpenAI context compaction for sessions containing many screenshots, preventing image-size estimates from incorrectly causing compaction requests to be rejected.

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed compatibility with Command Code DeepSeek and other DeepSeek-family models by preserving the reasoning context required for warm OpenAI Responses sessions and correctly handling incomplete DSML tool-call wrappers in visible output.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Fixed

  • Fixed waiting for subagent follow-up messages: responses now appear as background jobs that can be waited on or canceled, and are delivered only once.
  • Improved /switch autocomplete so model and role suggestions use the same relevance ordering as the model picker, including support for @role aliases.
  • Fixed concurrent skill:// searches blocking other filesystem operations and delaying subagent artifact publication.
  • Fixed compatibility checks for browser relays from other OMP versions and added guidance for resolving stale connection-refused errors.
  • Fixed follow-up hashline edits being incorrectly rejected after earlier edits shifted anchored lines, while continuing to reject genuinely stale line references.
  • Fixed pi.exec() reporting exit code 0 when a process was terminated by a timeout or signal; terminated processes now report code -1.
  • Fixed /collab guests being unable to respond to setting-change approval and tool-issue report consent prompts.
  • Fixed follow-up hashline edits being rejected as anchored on lines "never displayed" after an earlier edit shifted those lines, when the replacement carries the anchored content; genuinely stale line numbers are still rejected (#14254 by @abilliontokens).
  • Fixed long /btw answers in Tern being clipped with no way to scroll: /btw now answers in the scrollable BTW history sheet (#14331 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed /btw answers longer than 4 KiB being cut off with […truncated] once they finished (#14331 by @H4vC)
  • In Tern, Esc puts the BTW history sheet away while an answer keeps streaming (/btw reopens it); x cancels the answer (#14331 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed

  • Fixed concurrent searches through host-provided filesystem callbacks so they no longer starve other asynchronous filesystem operations, and ensured canceled searches release promptly.

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Fixed

  • Fixed the Space key in the Git diff pane so it stages or unstages the focused hunk instead of scrolling or acting on the wrong change.
  • Fixed the BTW history sheet in Tern: the history list no longer collapses beside a long answer, the panes lose their foldable ## headings, and the arrow/page keys scroll the answer (#14331 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed a single saved side question in the BTW history panel opening on its one-row list: its answer now has focus, and Enter or f to follow up jumps to the bottom of the conversation (#14331 by @H4vC)

What's Changed

  • fix(pi-edit): accept shift-consistent hashline anchors carrying current content by @abilliontokens in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14254
  • fix(agent): estimate image tokens from dimensions for native compaction fit by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14260
  • btw ux uplifts, tern specific. by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14331
  • fix(collab): mirrored cfg:// approval prompts to collab guests by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14282
  • fix(ai): filled reasoning_text on warm summary-only reasoning replay by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14294
  • fix(natives): moved provider searches off libuv workers by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14298
  • fix(browser): diagnosed stale relay after omp upgrades by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14299
  • fix(tui): restored Space row staging in git diff by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14329
  • fix(ai): preserved prose after incomplete dsml wrappers by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14273
  • fix(coding-agent): reported non-zero exit code for killed exec processes by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14290
